text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Daaaraaaahhh! ...Heh, how's that?!
choice_data_list: Good work! You put up a great time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That finishes up today's menu. All that's 
left is to cool down and—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, my body feels surprisingly light 
today... Alright! Bring on the next one, 
the next!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Got a problem with that? You ain't 
getting stronger unless you give it your 
all.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Like, I'm just running the way I want to. 
Just leave me alone already.
choice_data_list:
Still, resting your body is important 
too...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Haaah?! You looking down on me, punk?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I told you, this is a breeze! A total 
breeze! I could easily run another 100 
reps!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"I ain't that weak! Stop runnin' your 
mouth and let me do it!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I can feel her motivation, but I 
absolutely want to avoid overworking her. 
What should I do...?"
choice_data_list: ...All right. But I have one condition.
No, I really can't allow that!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I can feel her motivation, but I 
absolutely want to avoid overworking her. 
What should I do...?"
choice_data_list: ...All right. But I have one condition.
No, I really can't allow that!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...What condition?
choice_data_list:
I'll stick with you and give you full 
support!

I'll stay right by your side and support 
you!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Haaah!?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Why?! I don't need that! I'm more than 
enough on my own!
choice_data_list:
If you want to run, I'm with you all the 
way!

If you want to run, I'm with you all the 
way!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
You're suffocating me! Just get lost and 
go home!
choice_data_list: Wait! You need to hydrate before running!
Wait! You need to hydrate before running!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Ngggh! Aaaaargh! Stop following meeeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Afterward, Espoir City continued her 
self-training while receiving support."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
You bastard...! Are you screwing with me, 
huh!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can understand her frustration... but as 
her Trainer, this is something I cannot 
compromise on.
choice_data_list:
No matter what you say, I'm making sure 
you get some rest!

No matter what you say, I'm making sure 
you get some rest!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph! Bring it on. Though, you know—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Like hell I'm backing down! I'm gonna 
force you to acknowledge me, just you 
watch!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Afterward, the two argued back and 
forth with neither giving in, and as a 
result, Espoir City ended up having to 
rest her body."
